name: Weekly Usage Report — DB metrics → Slack

parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS issues_fixed FROM run_history WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tokens_total), 0)::bigint AS tokens_used FROM agent_analytics_runs WHERE completed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id)::int AS active_tenants FROM run_history WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS new_signups FROM accounts WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_cents), 0)::bigint AS revenue_cents FROM kpi_metrics WHERE snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
